h_sob26_l10n.text: Automating SeedSigner's localization (i18n) workflows to remove routine burden from translators, contributors, and maintainers while improving review quality and safety.
h_sob26_l10n.baseText: 2026 term: translation automation and the review workflow around it.

h_onf_agents.text: Developed LangChain/LangGraph agents to automate circular analysis for SEBI, RBI, IRDAI, and AMFI, reducing interpretation time by 90% and saving 100+ hours/update.
h_onf_agents.baseText: Built LangChain/LangGraph agents from scratch that automate circular analysis for various regulators like SEBI, RBI, AMFI, etc., cutting interpretation time by ~90% and saving 100+ hours per regulatory update.

h_onf_search.text: Designed a search agent for 200+ circulars and 20k+ clauses, providing cited, context-aware answers.
h_onf_search.baseText: Designed a search agent over 2000+ circulars and 500,000+ clauses that answers with citations instead of raw matches.

h_sob25_bip85.text: Extended BIP-85 support on SeedSigner (air-gapped Bitcoin hardware wallet) to enable direct child seed loading.
h_sob25_bip85.baseText: 2025 term: extended BIP-85 support, so child seeds load directly on-device.

h_ss_micro.text: Refactored ONDC monolith into microservices (Go/Django), handling 10k+ daily txns with 2x throughput.
h_ss_micro.baseText: Refactored the ONDC monolith into Go/Django microservices handling 10k+ daily transactions at 2x the previous throughput.

h_ss_latency.text: Reduced API latency from ~5s to ~1s through architectural optimizations and resource management.
h_ss_latency.baseText: Cut API latency from ~5s to ~1s through architectural changes and resource management.

h_ss_agent.text: Built an agentic AI system integrated with ONDC, Uber, and Rapido using browser automation for end-to-end booking workflows.
h_ss_agent.baseText: Built an agentic booking system integrating ONDC, Uber, and Rapido through browser automation.

h_as_schema.text: Engineered dynamic schema parsing, enabling the agent to adapt to changing DB structures with 100% syntax accuracy.
h_as_schema.baseText: Engineered dynamic schema parsing so the agent adapts to changing database structures.

h_crux_bitsgpt.text: [**BitsGPT:**](https://github.com/crux-bphc/bitsgpt-rewrite) Architected a multi-agent RAG chatbot using LangGraph and vector DBs to handle academic queries with context-aware responses.
h_crux_bitsgpt.baseText: Built BitsGPT, a multi-agent RAG chatbot (LangGraph + vector DB) for academic queries.

h_crux_chrono.text: [**Chronofactorem:**](https://github.com/crux-bphc/chronofactorem-rewrite) Engineered an Elasticsearch-powered [search service](https://github.com/crux-bphc/search-service) indexing the entire university course catalog and student timetables for sub-second retrieval.
h_crux_chrono.baseText: Contributed to Chronofactorem, with an Elasticsearch-powered search service.

h_crux_gcal.text: [**Chrono2GCal:**](https://github.com/Chaitanya-Keyal/Chrono2GCal) Developed a Python automation tool to auto-sync semester timetables to Google Calendar.
h_crux_gcal.baseText: Built Chrono2GCal, a Python tool auto-syncing semester timetables to Google Calendar.
